Freelance 101: Start Your Freelancing Journey with Confidence

An introductory session for anyone curious about freelancing: what the work really involves, how to find a direction that suits you, and how to prepare for your first client.

Who it’s for

Students, fresh graduates, career shifters, and beginners exploring freelancing.

What the session covers

  • What freelancing really is
  • Different freelance careers
  • Finding your niche
  • Preparing your portfolio
  • Getting your first client
  • Common mistakes beginners make

What you’ll take away

  • Understand how freelancing works
  • Identify a niche that suits you
  • Build confidence in starting your freelance journey
  • Take clear next steps toward becoming a freelancer

These are learning goals. The session does not guarantee clients, income, or employment.

Audience
Students, fresh graduates, career shifters, and beginners exploring freelancing.
